title: Rosalind and the Ember
author: L. M. Joubert
blurb: Odile Kavanagh, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
